source.title: The Heart of Hakkar
source.description: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within.  Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
source.objective: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
source.completion:
Ah, the Heart of Hakkar.  So the Soulflayer has been slain!  Our world is saved!

<name>, your service to us cannot be overstated.  You truly are a hero of this realm!
